newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flows fall for 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flows fall for 2-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds fell to $71 million for the two days ended March 10 compared with $1.49 billion for the three-day period ended March 6, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracker said aggressive growth funds posted outflows of $124 million from inflows of $409 million, growth funds dropped to outflows of $7 million versus inflows of $360 million, and international funds fell to inflows of $134 million compared with $409 million.

Bond funds rose to inflows of $291 million from $60 million, according to Trim Tabs. Muni funds rose to inflows of $246 million from $150 million, and corporate/income/global funds had inflows of $66 million versus outflows of $57 million.
